svg.title: Mifos Workflow architecture
svg.desc: An application calls the workflow engine through nine engine-neutral usecases. The engine calls the application through one adapter and the process dispatcher.
svg.text: One application · one engine · two directions
One implementation per engine. Only the selected engine registers beans:
Embedded: a service task expression calls the mifosAdapter bean. Remote: a job worker, external task or external worker job of type or topic mifosAdapter.
